headline: Bitcoin is flat in the mid-$64,000s with fear still extreme, as US bitcoin funds saw fresh outflows and the Fed's minutes and Anthropic's record share sale both land overnight Bangkok time.

market.asOf: Read at about 07:55-08:00 UTC Wed 18 Nov (about 15:00 Bangkok) on CoinGecko: BTC $64,581.44 (down 0.30% in 24 hours), ETH $1,809.53 (down 0.60%), SOL $75.12 (up 3.10%). Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index 12 (10 yesterday, 32 a week ago, 53 a month ago), read at about 07:57 UTC Wed 18 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin stuck below $65,000 as US bitcoin funds see outflows ahead of the Fed's minutes
stories.summary: Bitcoin is barely moving just under $65,000 while traders wait for minutes of the Fed's October meeting, out later today. US spot bitcoin funds lost money on Tuesday, and markets now see a December Fed rate rise as close to certain.
points: Bitcoin was at $64,801.52, up 0.16%, in CoinDesk's live coverage on Wednesday morning.

US spot bitcoin ETFs had net outflows of $239.9 million on Tuesday 17 Nov, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $209.5 million; spot ether ETFs lost $29.1 million, per Farside data reported by MarsBit via KuCoin.
CME FedWatch showed a 96% chance of a 0.25-point December rate rise, to 4.25%, per CoinDesk. These are market bets, not a Fed decision.
Bitcoin fell 12.6% last week and closed below its 200-week average, about $68,000, per CoinDesk.
Minutes of the Fed's 27-28 October meeting are due at 2:00pm ET Wednesday (02:00 Thursday Bangkok), per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Anthropic's giant share sale prices today after orders reportedly came in about 7 times over
stories.summary: AI company Anthropic is due to set the price of its first public share sale on Wednesday, with Nasdaq trading as ANT from Thursday. Reports say demand was strong enough to price at or above the top of its range.
points: Bloomberg reports Anthropic will price at or above the top of its $70-78 range after orders of close to 7 times the shares on offer; the Wall Street Journal reports it could go above $80, per PYMNTS.
At $78 it would be valued near $1.4 trillion and raise $90.4 billion, made of a $64.4 billion base offering and a $26 billion private placement, per PYMNTS.
The order book was set to close at 4:00pm ET, per KuCoin.
Nasdaq has confirmed Anthropic's first trading day as Thursday 19 Nov on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, per its trader notice.

stories.title: Nvidia beats and raises its outlook, but an SEC probe report and leadership turmoil cloud the picture
stories.summary: Nvidia reported sales well above forecasts, gave guidance ahead of analysts' estimates and added $150 billion to its share buyback. Its shares rose after hours, but a report of an SEC investigation and the exit of Jensen Huang keep the risk high.
points: Revenue was $115.8 billion against $108.8 billion expected, and earnings $2.68 a share against $2.47, per CoinDesk.
Data center revenue was $107.6 billion, per CoinDesk.
Nvidia guided next quarter's revenue to $127.4-132.6 billion, against the $125.3 billion analysts expected, per CoinDesk.
The Wall Street Journal reported the SEC opened a civil probe into whether Nvidia's disclosures misled investors, per TechCrunch.
The company added $150 billion to its buyback authorization and shares rose more than 4% after hours, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Judge clears the 'MEV brothers' in $25M Ethereum case
briefs.summary: US District Judge Jessica Clarke acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno of fraud and money-laundering conspiracy over an alleged $25M exploit of trading bots, ending the first US criminal case over MEV, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: CFTC orders Kalshi to halt Trump 'mention' markets
briefs.summary: The CFTC ordered Kalshi to stop listing contracts on what President Trump will say and opened proceedings; Kalshi says it is complying, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Coinbase crypto-backed loans now in all 50 US states
briefs.summary: New York was the last state added; users can borrow USDC against BTC, ETH or SOL, and the product has made over $3.4B in loans since January 2025, per The Block.

briefs.title: Binance hacker wallets wake up
briefs.summary: About 74,880 ETH (about $136.8M) moved after two weeks of silence; Elliptic says about $2.85B of the roughly $6.43B 29 Oct theft is frozen or seized, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Solana Foundation takes majority stake in CoinGecko
briefs.summary: The price was not disclosed; the foundation plans to add Solana-powered trading to CoinGecko's site and app, which has 18M registered users, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: XRP whales moved about $270M, but not to exchanges
briefs.summary: 281M XRP went into two non-exchange wallets during the selloff, which CoinDesk reads as a custody move rather than selling.

briefs.title: Tampered hardware wallets reported in Dubai
briefs.summary: Two owners report thefts from Ledger devices, one bought at an authorized Dubai retailer, including 507,000 USDT, per Cointelegraph. Buy hardware wallets direct from the maker where you can.

briefs.title: Ark buys crypto stocks, sells Nvidia
briefs.summary: On Monday Ark bought about $23M of Block, $10.4M of Circle and $6.4M of Coinbase shares and sold about $84.8M of Nvidia, per The Block.

calendar.note: CoinShares call at 8:00am ET and Bullish call at 8:30am ET, per their announcements on Finviz. Housing starts at 8:30am ET: forecast 1.27M (Finviz) or 1.24M (consensus in TD Economics' table), prior 1.221M.

calendar.event: Fed minutes from the October meeting
calendar.note: Minutes of the 27-28 October meeting. Fed's Barr speaks at 1:35pm ET, Williams at 2:30pm ET and Kashkari at 4:15pm ET, per Finviz and TD Economics.

calendar.event: Anthropic share sale priced, then first Nasdaq trading as ANT
calendar.note: Pricing Wednesday, range $70-78, per KuCoin; first trading day Thursday 19 Nov, per Nasdaq's trader notice (no time given; the regular open is 9:30am ET, 21:30 Bangkok).

Kristin Johnson and Steven Levine before the Senate Banking Committee, per the committee's page.

calendar.note: About 28,300 BTC, roughly $1.8B, of options expire at 08:00 UTC, per CryptoTicker. The bigger monthly expiry, about $5.7B, is Fri 27 Nov.

calendar.note: GDP forecast 3.4%, per Finviz. PCE prior 3.6% a year (core 3.1%); no consensus yet. Claims move to Wednesday for Thanksgiving. Fed Beige Book at 2:00pm ET, per Finviz.

calendar.note: NYSE closed Thursday and closes at 1:00pm ET Friday, per NYSE.

calendar.note: Decision at 2:00pm ET Wed 9 Dec (02:00 Thu 10 Dec Bangkok), press conference 2:30pm ET, per the Federal Reserve. CME FedWatch put the odds at 96% for a 0.25-point rise, per CoinDesk.
